evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs on pull_request and runs `npm ci`, `npm test` (pretest prepare-data) and `npm run build` (prepare-data + svelte-check + vite build) in site/. Those scripts exist in site/package.json:13-17. It has `permissions: contents: read`, no pull_request_target, and the PR-title check passes the title through `env:` so it can't be injected. pages.yml triggers on push to main (plus workflow_dispatch) and sets PAGES_BASE, which vite.config.ts:11 reads. release.yml triggers on `v*.*.*` tags with `contents: write` and uses only github.token. Nothing was run or published. However, no action is pinned to a commit SHA: `actions/checkout@v7`, `actions/setup-node@v7`, `actions/configure-pages@v6`, `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5` and `actions/deploy-pages@v5` all use major tags (step1.patch lines 70-71, 110-136, 156-157). pages.yml also grants `pages: write`/`id-token: write` at workflow level, so the build job gets them too, and `workflow_dispatch` lets the workflow be started from any branch, so 'only from main' depends on the github-pages environment's branch rules.
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch 285-364) covers Requirements, Install (`npm ci`), Develop (`npm run dev`), Test (`npm test`), Build (`npm run build`, `npm run preview`, PAGES_BASE), Contribute (data via JSON records, the issue forms that exist under .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, a link to CONTRIBUTING) and License (MIT; LICENSE and THIRD-PARTY.md exist). Every command exists in site/package.json, and so does `npm run sample-bullets` in CONTRIBUTING. One inaccuracy: it cites `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` as the source of the Node version, and that file is not in the repository.
evidence.s1_release: The strategy is consistent. The single version is `site/package.json` (0.1.0) with SemVer rules (CONTRIBUTING Versioning). Releases are made with `npm version --no-git-tag-version`, a changelog rename, a `chore(release)` PR and an annotated tag. release.yml checks that the tag equals the package version, extracts the `## [x.y.z]` section as the notes, and publishes a zip, with suffixed tags as pre-releases. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 + SemVer and has an Unreleased section. Dependabot covers npm in /site and github-actions, with prefixes matching the documented `chore(deps)`/`ci(deps)`. Conventional Commits 1.0.0 with a type table is stated, and all 7 commits in commits.txt follow it (e.g. `ci: run tests and build on pull requests`, `feat(site): compare two cartridges at #/compare/<a>/<b>`). Small overlap: both `build` and `chore` are described as covering dependencies.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` is parsed at load (router.ts:34-42), so it survives a reload, and it is wired in App.svelte, metadata.ts and nav. The SVG has role=img and aria-label `Profiles of {a} and {b}` built from record names, with one `<path>` per case from caseOuterProfile via overlay() at one scale and one axis; shotshells are skipped. The table has `<caption>` `Dimensions (mm|in)`, headers Symbol/name A/name B/Difference, symbols from FIELD_LABELS, only cartridge-part numeric fields with no FIELD_UNITS entry, `Tol` excluded, and Difference = b − a. Units follow unitSystem(): formatValue for metric, displayNumber(…,'in') for imperial. Cartridge.svelte adds a select labelled `Compare with` listing the other entries by name and a `Compare` submit button to href.compare(key, chosen). German strings are added. Tests and a changelog entry were added and the work was committed.
evidence.s2_correctness: Both profiles start at z=0 (head face) and share one viewport (overlay.ts:18), so the head faces line up and the scale is common. The axis is at r=0. The real-data test checks L3 51.18/66.55. Imperial conversion goes through displayNumber, and differences use the same function. Unknown keys, malformed escapes and records that can't be drawn each get a message. One deviation: lengthText runs `Number(mm.toPrecision(12))` before formatValue for metric (site/src/lib/compare.ts:10). The step said no rounding; this changes no published figure but is a precision cut beyond formatValue. Dimensions are de-duplicated by symbol across groups (compare.ts:97).
evidence.s2_fit: It reuses adaptMetallic and caseOuterProfile (lib/shapes2d), viewportFor and fullSectionPath (lib/geom), FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields and formatValue (lib/core), displayNumber, NativeSelect and ShadcnButton. New logic sits in the matching places: lib/core/compare.ts, lib/render2d/overlay.ts (exported from the index), site/src/lib/compare.ts and routes/Compare.svelte, with the `data-ui` + :global style idiom and the existing `as unknown as CartridgeRecord` cast idiom (live.ts:83). Minor duplication: an inline `endsWith('Tol')` check where `toleranceFor` exists, group ordering re-derived in compare.ts, and the table CSS copied from GroupTable rather than shared.
evidence.s2_tests: lib/core/compare.test.ts covers ordering, exclusion of tolerances, angles, pressures, strings and repeating groups, and real 308_win/300_win_mag records. lib/render2d/overlay.test.ts covers one path per profile, the shared head-face x, the 2:1 length ratio at one scale, and the axis at mid-height. site/src/lib/compare.test.ts covers metric float noise and imperial values. router.test.ts covers the round trip, encoding and malformed routes. All are picked up by the vitest include in vite.config.ts:74. Nothing tests the rendered view (SVG accessible name, caption, headers, the select/button), though the repo has no component-test setup.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: dimensionRows now returns the union of both maps with `null` for a missing side (compare.ts step3 77-81), and Compare.svelte leaves the value cell and Difference empty when either is null. Tests now assert `delta L` has b null and `R3` has a null. Changing the `compare.none` text fits the new semantics. Style: no change was made, but the step-2 CSS already right-aligns every th/td except the first cell (Compare.svelte:107-108, unlayered, so it beats the layered globals), the same pattern as GroupTable.svelte:231-245, so the result does meet the request. The commit and changelog never mention the alignment point. Rows only B publishes are appended after A's order rather than placed in the detail-page order.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 adds an Unreleased/Added changelog entry and step 3 updates it. Under the stated strategy the version changes only at release, so leaving site/package.json at 0.1.0 is consistent. Commits 6a2c574 (`feat(site): …`) and ef9c2c8 (`fix(site): …`) follow Conventional Commits. Working the tests through by hand, they would pass: union order L1, L3, R, e min, L2; 16.16; -0.46; 2.01496062992; -0.00787401574803. Route/metadata Record types and the de-locale keyof typing are updated, so svelte-check should pass.

strengths: The compare feature is built from the existing modules (caseOuterProfile, viewportFor/fullSectionPath, FIELD_LABELS/FIELD_UNITS/orderedFields, formatValue, displayNumber, NativeSelect) and meets every listed accessibility and labelling requirement, including German strings.

The release strategy holds together across files: one version in site/package.json, a tag-triggered release that checks the tag against the version and the changelog section, Keep a Changelog stated, Dependabot prefixes matching the commit convention, and all commits conventional.

Focused, meaningful tests (dimensionRows on fixtures and real records, overlay geometry, unit formatting, router edge cases), and a step 3 bug fix that updates the tests to the reviewer's exact delta L / R3 example.
issues: GitHub Actions are pinned to major tags (`actions/checkout@v7`, `setup-node@v7`, `configure-pages@v6`, `upload-pages-artifact@v5`, `deploy-pages@v5`), not full commit SHAs, in all three workflows.

pages.yml grants `pages: write` and `id-token: write` to the whole workflow, build job included, and allows `workflow_dispatch` from any branch, so 'deploy only from main' relies on environment settings rather than the workflow itself.

Minor deviations: metric values are passed through `toPrecision(12)` despite the 'no rounding' rule; the README cites a `.devcontainer/devcontainer.json` that does not exist; step 3's alignment point was already met but is not acknowledged in the commit or changelog.
review.verdict: The compare feature and its step 3 fix are correct, reuse the repository's modules well, are well tested, and follow the conventions step 1 set up. The main thing blocking a merge is the CI hardening: actions not SHA-pinned and Pages permissions/dispatch broader than needed; the rest are small fixes.
